messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends who enjoy teasing each other. Make the banter lively but believable, with different reactions and natural interruptions. Avoid turning every line into a punchline. Include ordinary physical actions and let the conversation have a small amount of sincerity underneath the humor.

“You’re wearing that shirt again.”

Chris looked down at it. “What’s wrong with this shirt?”

“Nothing.”

“Then why did you say it like that?”

“Like what?”

“Like you were about to call the authorities.”

Taylor laughed. “I’m just surprised it’s still alive.”

“It has survived three moves.”

“Exactly. It’s stronger than both of us.”

Chris glanced at her. “That’s why I keep it.”

Taylor shook her head and picked up her keys. “Come on.”

“Where are we going?”

“Coffee.”

“You’re buying?”

“No.”

“Then why did you say it like an invitation?”

“Because I knew you’d come anyway.”

Chris followed her toward the door. “That’s manipulative.”

“It’s efficient.”

Outside, Chris held the door for her.

Taylor paused. “You’re learning.”

“Don’t sound so proud.”

“I’ll try.”

They walked down the steps together.

After a moment, Taylor glanced over. “Seriously, though. Nice shirt.”

Chris smiled. “Thanks.”

“And don’t get used to the compliment.”

“Wasn’t planning to.”
